correctness.rationale: The one-to-one complement parameterization is proved by invertibility of \(1-h\); the commutation equation \((1-h)(1-k)(x-y)=0\) excludes cross-complement simplices, and the \(p\)-group hypothesis ensures isolated kernel vertices. Integral join Künneth gives the full homology lattice. Conjugation is affine on the complement indices but fixes H-coordinates, yielding the exact permutation tensor action and the degree-zero augmentation kernel. Quotient stabilizers and free fixed-point-free complement action give an actual homeomorphism. Direct finite checks in verify.py pass for (7,6), (13,12), (31,15) and (43,21), with a three-prime join check. Universal proof does not rely on finite sampling.

value.rationale: A natural infinite solvable-group family not treated by the motivating source receives its entire homotopy decomposition, integral inner-conjugation homology, a three-valued top character and an actual geometric quotient formula. It gives arbitrarily many non-isolated components and higher-dimensional free homology rather than a routine fixed finite census; the Frobenius action is precisely the structural hypothesis making these phenomena and affine symmetry transparent. This exact information is not recovered from the group prime graph or the complement join Betti rank alone.
